verdict.rationale: Bevy has no editor, but its code-first cargo workflow means an agent can create and save ECS scenes and entities in Rust and trigger builds without one. A first-party Bevy Remote Protocol is mentioned only in passing, as the base for a small community tool (bevy_brp), so live programmatic control is thinly evidenced and undocumented in the pack. Missing for 10: an editor to drive, documentation of the Remote Protocol's ability to create entities and edit properties at runtime, an official agent or MCP integration, and independent hands-on corroboration.
